frequency_question: How often does the finance ministry execute announced structural digital payment fee modifications within the designated timeline despite stakeholder pushback?
membership_rule: Includes all announced policy directives on payment aggregator charges or merchant discount rates by the central ministry. Excludes monetary policy rate changes and routine budgetary tax adjustments.
